helper_custody: Released after final32-control check; no active jobs. Only ignored helper and fresh capacity-* receipts written.

bounded_controls.scope: Bounded in-memory toy bytes/count boundaries only; no actual package or actual compiler-copy proof acceptance.

allowed_input_transition: PLMP5-to6 or unchanged codec version; PLMP3/4/5/6 reader supported; no metadata normalization/default synthesis in comparison.

after_adapter.shared_combined_rows: All three quality rows may share actual build argv, archive pin and full manifest entries/variants; exactly one selected quality row and variant required.
after_adapter.ordinary_proofs: Nested validate and verify contain actual argv/exit_code0 and optional log path (absolute or repository-relative). Default log path is report-adjacent QUALITY-kind.log. Successful require-current and ordinary validate JSON must match package fingerprint, source/catalog/deps and selected quality.
after_adapter.compiler_path: Actual build/validate/verify argv tool paths must agree unchanged. Optional report.compiler_pin supplies preserved identical compiler bytes; compiler_copy_receipt pins source_original_path and destination hashes. No original argv is rewritten.

optional_compiler_pin.compiler_pin: Actual immutable preserved compiler-copy path, absolute or repository-relative.
optional_compiler_pin.compiler_copy_receipt: Actual immutable JSON path, absolute or repository-relative.

copy_receipt_fields.source_original_path: Actual original build argv[0] path; must match actual validate/verify argv[0].
copy_receipt_fields.compiler_pin: Actual preserved destination path; must equal report.compiler_pin.
copy_receipt_fields.source_sha256: Original actual compiler hash, equals report.compiler_sha256 and build-inputs.tool_sha256.
copy_receipt_fields.compiler_pin_sha256: Same original hash, must equal actual preserved-file bytes.

optional_compiler_pin.provenance: Actual original-path current bytes, if present, are separately recorded; they never replace the preserved historical tool identity. Copy receipt/file identities are checked again at completion.
